title: storyboard — card plan
description: Output of the storyboard planner: a JSON array of one card per beat, in playback order (ONLY the array — no prose, no code fence). Beat count keys off the §B length band (~4–12), not a fixed number. Grading criteria: .claude/references/craft-bar/deliverable-storyboard.md.

brief.description: A single structured string carrying labelled fields so assemble-board can map it into film.json: VO line (spoken) | On-screen text | SOUND/SFX (the music-bed feel for this beat; a deliberate hit as a structured cue '<sound>@<anchor>', sound from click·tick·pop·hit·whoosh·swish, anchor = the VO word it lands on or a timecode; else '—' for a quiet beat) | Timecode (start–end, ~Ns) | Role | Focal element that must dominate the safe area | Signature move (does THIS card carry the board's one signature device? how; else '—') | Hero-number/receipt card (the number/receipt if THIS beat owns it full-frame; else '—') | Ground/colour | Font (the moodboard's sourced face) | Camera intent (frame …, zoom ~n).
